question: Could you review our records in June 2022 and identify which countries have the longest streak of consecutive inserted city dates? Please list the 2-letter length country codes of these countries.
sql:
WITH june_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    country_code_2,
    TRY_CAST(insert_date AS DATE) AS d
  FROM cities
  WHERE insert_date >= '2022-06-01' AND insert_date <= '2022-06-30'
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code_2,
    d,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY d) AS rn
  FROM june_dates
),
groups AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code_2,
    d,
    rn,
    d - CAST(rn AS INTEGER) AS grp
  FROM numbered
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code_2,
    grp,
    COUNT(*) AS streak_len
  FROM groups
  GROUP BY country_code_2, grp
)
SELECT country_code_2, MAX(streak_len) AS max_streak
FROM streaks
GROUP BY country_code_2
HAVING MAX(streak_len) = (SELECT MAX(max_streak) FROM (SELECT country_code_2, MAX(streak_len) AS max_streak FROM streaks GROUP BY country_code_2) t)
ORDER BY country_code_2
